content: Ayesu bhajigana na bhandu palitombi
Ayesu pabhakagabhona malubhalo ga bhandu, bhakakweela nnani ja litombi bhakatama konokwe. Bhabhachijigana bhabhe bhakaajendela,
na bhenabho bhakajemeka kwaajigananga,
Kuhangalala kwa kweli
“Bhapakuachukanga bhenibhala bhabhaalolea Annoongo,

content.text: kwa kubhee umwenye gwa Annoongo nga gwabhenji.
kwa kubhee bhapakwapekeanga chilambo chibhee chabhenji.
Bhapakuachukanga bhabhapalanga muno kutenda gabhagapala Annoongo,
Bhapakuachukanga bhabhabhilinge na ntima gwa kualala,
kwa kubhee bhenabho bhapakemwa bhaana bha Annoongo.
Bhapakuachukanga bhabhapotekwa ligongo lya kutenda gagapalikwa na Annoongo,
kwa kubhee umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde nga gwabhenji.”

content: “Ntekuachukanga mwangota handa bhandu bhapakuntukananga, kongo bhabhi kunnagianga na kumkopokeanga kila namuna ja ubhou ligongo lya nenga.
Nhachukange na kuhangalala kwa kubhee ngwahupa jinunji nga ngolongwa kunani kulihunde. Henela nga chibhakaatendelanga akaalondoi bha Annoongo bhabhakibha tangu ja mwangota.”
Ngeleka na lumuli
“Mwangota nga ngeleka pakati ja bhandu pachilambo. Nambo ngeleka handa jihobhite kunong'a kwabhe jipakunong'ea niki? Ngapalikwa kabhele, nambo kujijea panja na kulebhatikwa na bhandu.”
“Mwangota nga lumuli lwa chilambo. Mwangota nga handa nyuumba jijichengikwe nnani ja litombi ngakomboleka kuchiiya.
Na bhandu ngajaakiha taa na kujibheka pachitombenga. Badala jabhe bhakalubheka lumuli kunani kundepela, na jenejo jikamulikila kwa bhandu bhoa mu nyuumba jela.
Hela hela, lumuli gwinu gumulikile nnoongi ja bhandu, ili bhapate kugabhona mahengo ginu gammbone, bhaalumbalile Atati bhinu bhabhabhii kunani kulihunde.”
Ayesu bhatendakujigana bhandu malagilo
“Nkoto kuganikiha ndekuhika kubhoa malagilo ga Amusa gabhapatite kubhoka kwa Annoongo na majigano ga akaalondoi, ila ndekuhika kunnangianga genago malagilo nga ga kweli.
Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli, mpaka penapo lihunde na chilambo pachipakupeta, jaakwa hata chipande chichokochoko cha malagilo ga Amusa chichipakuhutwa mpaka goha gateendeke.

Bahi, amundu bhoa bhala bhangajeketela hata lilagilo limo lichoko, na kwaajigana bhangi bhatendange henela, bhenabho bhapakubhehe achoko muno mu umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo. Nambo bhenibhala bhabhapakujeketela malagilo ga Annoongo na kwaajigana bhajingi bhapakubhee umwenye mu umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo.”
Ndenda kunnobholelanga kweli, handa ngatenda maha hikubho hiyaabhajila Annoongo handa chibhatendanga bhabhajigananga malagilo ga Amusa na Mafalisayo, ng'o ngajingilanga mu umwenye gwa Annoongo.
Majigano nnani ja lilaka
“Ntekujohanikia yakubhehe bhandu bha lolo pabhakalobholelwanga, ‘Nkotokoma!’ Bhoa bhala bhabhapakoma bhapakuhukumulwa.

Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, bhoabhala bhabhapakwaachimwa anung'una bhabhe bhapakuhukumulwa. Na bhoabhala bhabhapakwaabhelua anung'una jwabhe na kwabhona ngabha chilebhe bhapachitakiana kwa annyumbe. Na bhabhapakwaakema anung'una bhabhe, ‘Apumbavu,’ bhapalikwa kujingila mu lihembo lya moto gwangahimika machobha goha.
Bahi, handa mpeleka mabhokeo ginu nnoongi ja Annoongo, ngapena mkombokela anung'una bhinu abhi na bulwa na mwenga,
mmoe mbeeko jinu nnongi ja Annoongo, mmuje nkwelekane na anung'una bhinu, ngapena mmuje nnoongi ja Annoongo kubhoa mabhokeo ginu.”

“Nkwelekane na apwati bhinu muda mmi nndela pamo na bhenabho kujaula kwa annyumbe. Apwati bhinu bhapakunpeleka kwa annyumbe, na bhenabho annyumbe bhapakunpeleka kwa linyemba, na mwenga mpakutabhikwa kuligelecha.
Ndendakunnobholela kweli, mmokahopo monomwe mpaka nnyomole kulepa ulohi gwoha.”
Majigano nnani ja kuleka ngoongola
Ayesu akapunda kulongela, “Ntekujohanikianga yakubhehe bhandu bhatekulobholelwa, ‘Nkotokutendanga ngoongola!’”
Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, bhoabhala bhabhapa kunnola mwikege kwa kunnokolila, bahi bhatekutenda ngongola na bhenabho mwikege muntima gwabhe.

Bahi, handa lio linu lya kunnelo handa lunyambwie kutenda mabhou, mulibhoe na mulijee kutali. Mbaya muno kwaachinu kuchihobha chiungo chinu cha mmele gwinu, kuliko mmele gwinu goa kulekelekwa mu litanda lya mooto gwangahimika machobha goa.

Handa lubhoko lwinu lwa kunnnelo lunyambwie kutenda mabhou, muluhekete na kulujea kutali. Mbaya kwaachinu kuhobha chiungo chimo cha mmele gwinu, kuliko mmele gwinu goa kujingila mu lihembo lyangapela.
Ngani ja talaka
“Jijaandikwe mu majaandiko ga Annoongo, ‘Mundu joajola jwaapala kwaaleka hanu bhabhe, apalikwa kwaajandikila talaka.’”

Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, “Mundu handa apala kwaaleka hanu bhabhe ligongo lya lyohalela na ngabha ligongo lya ngoongola, atendakwatenda mwikege jonojwe kubhee jwa ngoongola, na jonojwe jwaapakwaalombela mwikege jonojwe jwaalekitwe na jono atenda ngoongola.”
Majigano nnani ja kulapila
“Ntekujohanikianga yakubhee bhandu bha lolo pabhakalobholelwa, ‘Nkotokuleka kutenda chinnongile, nambo hipalikwa kutenda yoha hintekuhaidi kwa Hangwana.’
Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, nkotokulapilanga choachela pantendakuhaidi, wala nkotokulapilanga kwa kunani kulihunde, kwa kubhee chenecho nga chitengu cha umwenye cha Annoongo,
Nkotokulapilanga kwa chilambo, kwakubhee nga mahali pakwe pa kubheka makongono, au ku Yelusalemu, wala nkotokulapilanga kwa Yelusalemu kubhee nga chilambo cha Amwenye akolo.
Na mwangota nkotokulapilanga kwa mutwe gwinu, maana ngakombola kulitenda hata lijunju linu limo kubhee lihuu au lipili.
Handa mpakulobhola, ‘Elo,’ bahi jibhee, ‘Elo.’ Na handa mpakulobhola, ‘Ngabha’ bahi jibhee, ‘Ngabha,’ choha chela chipakupunda genago kubhoka kwa bheni bhala Abhou.”
Majigano nnani ja kuchibhujikia
Ayesu akapunda kulongela, “Ntekujohanga yakubhee jikalobholekwa, ‘Lio kwa lio, na lino kwa lino.’
Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, nkotokummujikia chikubho amundu abohu. Mundu handa ampotite lijegwa lya kunnelo, mumtendebhukie kabhele lijegwa linu lya kunchiji.
Handa mundu ampelike kuchebule kupala bhapetule lichati linu, mwaaleke bhapetule kabhele na likoti linu.
Mundu handa bhapakunkulumikia kupetula nhigo gwinu maili jimo, mgupetule maili jibhele.
Bhabhapakunnyopa chilebhe mwapekee, nkotokwaajima bhabhapakuhika kunnyahika chilebhe choachela mwapekee.”
Kwaapalanga akaapwati
“Ntekujohanikianga yakubhee jitekulobholekwa, ‘Mwaapale andami ajinu, na kwaachimwa apwati bhinu.’
Nambo nenga ndendakunnobholelanga, mwaapalange akaapwati bhinu na kwaajopelanga kwa Annoongo bhabhampotekanga mwangota,

kupala mmangange bhaana bha Atati bhinu bhabhabhii kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo. Kwa kubhee bhenabho bhatendakwabhalakia lyobha lyabhe bhandu akaabhou na bhammbone, na kwaakomelekea hula bhandu bhammbone na akaabhou.
Jakwa ngwaupa joajela jimpakupatanga handa mpakwapalanga bhenibhala bhabhampalanga mwangota? Kwa kubhee hata bhabhatochanga kodi bhatendanga hela hela!
Hela hela handa mpakwapekeanga chalamu akaanung'una bhinu jikajabhe, bholi, ntekutendanga chilebhe changa yobheleka? Hata bhandu bhangaamanya Annoongo na bhenabho bhatendanga hela hela.
Bahi, mmangange bhandu mwangalemwa handa Atati bhinu bha kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo chibhabhile bhangalemwa!”
